basis.frozen_AAI10C_dev_positive: Linux candidate 0.0010241s vs matched 0.0019053s; Windows 0.0014762s vs matched 0.0025288s; only synthetic development efficiency, not science
basis.prior_negatives: AAI-09A scientific NO-GO; AAI-10A and AAI-10B development efficiency NO-GO; do not replay or tune

question: Does independent compact causal signature bank learn causal action-consequence structure enabling out-of-regime C/D transfer while protecting A/B memory, beating the strongest fully trained same-information conventional control at whole-process cost parity?

train.trial: One public initial (x,mediators,goal,reward,actions_taken=0), one publicly observed do-action consequence (actions_taken=1), both supplied to every learner in same deterministic order, no privileged formula/label

fork.checkpoint: After 64 train rows, each learner makes byte-exact canonical checkpoint; A return, B continuation, C and D unfamiliar independently cold-restore each frozen checkpoint
fork.actions: Common exogenous action determined by SHA256 world-scope and trial index without learner actions or hidden law; every learner sees same public initial+observed action consequence

evaluate.independent_episodes: For each model/condition/N/context re-restore frozen after-challenge checkpoint and issue public initial state; let model observe first initial row and then its own actual consequence feedback; no feedback from other model's actions, no test episode knowledge carried into next context
evaluate.score: Terminal actual public reward. No-op is allowed; if chosen action executed, update model only on actual public consequence. Also score terminal 2-bit goal match and actual intervention count
evaluate.world_unit: A single world ID is the bootstrap unit, not contexts, interventions or conditions

controls.ablation: AAI-10C single-slot full-budget (64+16 challenge+up to3 eval rows <=83, under frozen 96 cap) no operator reuse
controls.reactive: Original AAI10A negative diagnostic, not matched
controls.oracle: Privileged known-law actual rollout diagnostic only; NEVER a learner or fastest matched

metrics.primary: Average terminal reward over C/D worlds for challenge N=2 and N=4 (16 contexts each), candidate vs BEST matched conventional selected by its own mean C/D reward. World-paired bootstrap, 2048 resamples with fixed public bootstrap seed 39092; percentile 2.5/97.5 using entire world units (64 TRANSFER worlds). Candidate - strongest >=+0.08 and lower 95% >0.
metrics.ablation: Candidate minus full-budget one-slot >=0.05 and paired lower95 >0
metrics.headroom: Oracle minus best matched >=0.15 and paired lower95>0. If strongest conventional >=95% of maximum possible terminal reward (2.0) -> HEADROOM_INADEQUATE_NO_PROMOTION.
metrics.goal: Unfamiliar C/D two-goal exact completion fraction >=0.80
metrics.cold_retention: A return and B hold reward vs same strongest conventional within -0.02 each; saved original checkpoint unchanged; slot A preserved and retrievable >=0.60
metrics.negative: 32 independent NEGATIVE worlds; within public-feedback challenge phase, swap mediator observations of distinct trial x contexts preserving output-bit marginals, before model learn, while never changing a test outcome; actual-vs-corrupted candidate transfer reward >= +0.10 paired 95% lower>0
metrics.cost: time.perf_counter process train+challenge+episode learning/planning plus checkpoint cold-restore total; peak memory tracemalloc, bytes of frozen checkpoints; candidate <=2x fastest eligible matched (not oracle/negative); independent cold restores included for both
metrics.winner: If any mandatory threshold fails => VALID_NEGATIVE_NO_INTEGRATION; malformed information separation or incomplete comparator => INVALID_PROTOCOL. First verify headroom, matched goal reward, and cold/negative controls; never change prereg or model after primary results.

seeds.source_only_requires: Hardcoded fixture x/goal/action rows; NO call to reserved science world generator; --primary always rejected

exit.engineering: frozen prereg-before-code, source-bound fair comparator, no oracle leakage, equal rows/action allowance, cold restore independently, no shared episode state, disarmed primary, negative fixture tests; original 54 repo +8 benchmark +10 AAI10A +11 AAI10C +new AAI10D full final candidate tests on both OS; generated code atlas PASS; untouched main
exit.scientific: UNVERIFIED until separately scoped first-use authorization and source-qualified cohort runner, even if synthetic structural tests PASS
